title: SUNRISE SOCIAL! | Copi Cafe 71 | Cornucopias
description:
Get ready for an exciting episode of COPI Cafe. Josh and Rob discuss the recent listing on Uniswap giving the project more exposure to the ETH community. 
Josh talks about our early stages of onboarding our new PR firm Wachsman, renowned for their extensive experience in working with blockchain projects.
We are also joined by everyone's favorite guest, David, our Creative Director. He talks about all the latest build features, and our top priority right now.... LAND. He walks us through the process of developing the land plots as well as the environmental art in the themed zones. And we wrap up with a special announcement for a another group of NFT holders. Sit back and enjoy, it's a good one!

00:00 Beverage Choices
03:30 Uniswap
05:45 Wachsman 
09:16 David Special Guest 
11:36 Sunrise Social
51:09 Leak!
53:07 Friday Night Stream
54:26 Graphics Cards

Cornucopias is a free to play MMORPG game created on Unreal Engine 5.

Cornucopias offers each player the ability to pave their own way in a wide variety of gameplay including: building, crafting, farming, mining, logging, fishing, PVP combat, PVE Combat, exploring, flying, trading, racing, upgrading and MMO leveling. Cornucopias players also have the ability to own their own in-game assets, such as land plots, vehicles and much more. Cornucopias is a network of floating domes (colonies) in a post-apocalyptic alternate version of Earth. The domes have diverse themes and characteristics. Here, players can travel around the vast world of Cornucopias and complete quests or choose their own path.
